# Backpacker Magazine

> Expert source for backpacking, hiking trails, outdoor gear reviews, wilderness skills, and backcountry survival guidance.

Backpacker Magazine is the leading authority on backpacking and hiking, offering comprehensive resources including trail planning with GPS maps, expert gear reviews, wilderness safety and survival skills, hiking fitness training, and real-world stories from the backcountry. The site covers major trails like the Appalachian Trail, Pacific Crest Trail, and Colorado Trail.

## Key Topics

- Backpacking Skills
- Hiking Trails
- Wilderness Safety
- Gear Reviews
- Hiking Fitness
- Survival Skills
- Trail Safety
- Backpacks
- Tents
- Thru-Hiking
- Appalachian Trail
- Pacific Crest Trail
- Outdoor Adventure
- Backcountry Survival
- Hiking Hazards

## Core Resources

- [Backpacker Magazine Homepage](https://www.backpacker.com): Expert source for backpacking, trails, gear, and skills
- [Featured Content](https://www.backpacker.com/featured): Featured content hub showcasing hiking fitness, safety, and backpacking skills
- [Trip Planning & Trails](https://www.backpacker.com/trips): Trip planning with GPS maps for Appalachian Trail, Zion, Colorado Trail
- [Outdoor Gear Reviews](https://www.backpacker.com/gear): Expert gear reviews for tents, backpacks, sleeping bags, and hiking equipment
- [Gear Deals](https://www.backpacker.com/deals): Aggregated deals on hiking boots, backpacks, tents, and outdoor gear from retailers

## Skills & Safety

- [Wilderness Skills](https://www.backpacker.com/skills): Wilderness skills guides: navigation, safety, gear repair, and hiking fitness
- [Survival Skills](https://www.backpacker.com/survival): Survival skills: fire-building, foraging, animal encounters, bear safety, knots
- [Hiking Fitness Training](https://www.backpacker.com/skills/backpacking-fitness/you-cant-just-hike-into-shape-here-are-the-4-muscle-groups-youre-missing): Hiking fitness guide: 18 exercises targeting muscle groups for injury prevention
- [Trail Maintenance & Muddy Trails](https://www.backpacker.com/skills/when-should-you-avoid-hiking-on-muddy-trails): Trail maintenance guide: when to avoid muddy trails to prevent erosion damage
- [2025 Summer Gear Guide](https://www.backpacker.com/collection/2025-summer-gear-guide): 2025 summer gear guide: tested tents, packs, sleeping bags, and hiking apparel

## Stories & News

- [Outdoor News & Events](https://www.backpacker.com/news-and-events): Outdoor news, conservation updates, trail access, and hiking rescue reports
- [Wilderness Survival Stories](https://www.backpacker.com/stories): Real survival stories from Pacific Crest Trail and Appalachian Trail hikers
- [Fowler-O'Sullivan Foundation: Finding Missing Hikers](https://www.backpacker.com/stories/fowler-osullivan-foundation-missing-hikers): Profile of Fowler-O'Sullivan Foundation's mission to find missing hikers
- [PCT Border Wall Access Update](https://www.backpacker.com/news-and-events/news/pct-border-wall-hikers-access-update): PCT access update: hikers can photograph U.S.-Mexico border with ID requirements

## Video & Visual Content

- [Backpacking Videos](https://www.backpacker.com/videos): Backpacking videos on gear, skills, trail footage, and wilderness survival

## Trip Guides

- [Spring Break Backpacking Trips](https://www.backpacker.com/trips/5-spring-break-backpacking-trips-to-avoid-the-snow-this-year): Guide to 3-5 day spring break backpacking trips in snow-free locations

- [Adam Roy Archives](https://www.backpacker.com/byline/adam-roy): Author archive for Adam Roy, Executive Editor at Backpacker Magazine
